title: Rheno's Goodbye

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Well, if you've got eyes on this, Ava must have done her job. Sorry for the theatrics. Couldn't risk Curzona messing up my timings.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if you've got eyes on this, Ava must have done her job. Sorry for the theatrics. Couldn't risk Curzona messing up my timings.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We need to decide what to do with these files.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to decide what to do with these files.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If we share them, we risk turning him into a martyr. People may try this again - a revolution of economic-murder at the expense of the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If we share them, we risk turning him into a martyr. People may try this again - a revolution of economic-murder at the expense of the corps.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if we delete it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if we delete it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And if we delete it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And if we delete it?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The world eventually returns to a kind of normality. Better for Curzona, but a return to the status quo for the citizens.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The world eventually returns to a kind of normality. Better for Curzona, but a return to the status quo for the citizens.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Are you sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Are you sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On second thoughts, let's hand it over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On second thoughts, let's hand it over.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: On second thoughts, let's hand it over.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: On second thoughts, let's hand it over.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Let's hand it over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Let's hand it over.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. Let's hand it over.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. Let's hand it over.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On second thoughts. Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On second thoughts. Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: On second thoughts. Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: On second thoughts. Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood. Transmitting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood. Transmitting.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood. Transmitting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood. Transmitting.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: This whole thing has been like trying to cook a Hobo's roast without burning the Sludge-Worm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This whole thing has been like trying to cook a Hobo's roast without burning the Sludge-Worm.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: But when you turned up, I realized the old man had made good on his plans. Good for him, I say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But when you turned up, I realized the old man had made good on his plans. Good for him, I say.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Well, here we are. I must be lying on the ground behind you. I wonder who's gonna clean this up? Hopefully, not Fletcher. That guy couldn't find a bloodstain in a bath.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, here we are. I must be lying on the ground behind you. I wonder who's gonna clean this up? Hopefully, not Fletcher. That guy couldn't find a bloodstain in a bath.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I digress. Curzona must be close now. To answer the burning question, yes, once I took my own life, I became the final victim of Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I digress. Curzona must be close now. To answer the burning question, yes, once I took my own life, I became the final victim of Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Get it? Hello? Me. I did all the murders!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get it? Hello? Me. I did all the murders!

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Doctors did what they could, but it was costly - so costly that I had to take up the aftermath job just to pay off the debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doctors did what they could, but it was costly - so costly that I had to take up the aftermath job just to pay off the debt.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Of course, as she grew weaker, the debt grew too, and the rest of my life became a footnote on a Curzona balance sheet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course, as she grew weaker, the debt grew too, and the rest of my life became a footnote on a Curzona balance sheet.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You know, a debt enforcer once tried to bribe me into having another child after she died, just so the credit line wouldn't end with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, a debt enforcer once tried to bribe me into having another child after she died, just so the credit line wouldn't end with me?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: By my estimations, I have permanently wiped out trillions in future debt. I just hope it's enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: By my estimations, I have permanently wiped out trillions in future debt. I just hope it's enough.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: There will be those who will question my execution - pun un-intended - but ultimately, the sacrifice will have been worth it. Aseptic's victims have fought in the most important war and won.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There will be those who will question my execution - pun un-intended - but ultimately, the sacrifice will have been worth it. Aseptic's victims have fought in the most important war and won.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Their sacrifice will be written across the sky in stars. They are the cure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Their sacrifice will be written across the sky in stars. They are the cure.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Down to business. Attached to this document is my confession and economic-manifesto.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Down to business. Attached to this document is my confession and economic-manifesto.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: The world needs to know this was worth something. Maybe it was worth everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The world needs to know this was worth something. Maybe it was worth everything.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Ciao for now, Shoku, I'll tell Thaddeus you said hello.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ciao for now, Shoku, I'll tell Thaddeus you said hello.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I feel a kind of... déjà vu. Books printed on paper? I... remember. I've read crime novels like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel a kind of... déjà vu. Books printed on paper? I... remember. I've read crime novels like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't be. Books haven't been printed on paper for over a hundred years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't be. Books haven't been printed on paper for over a hundred years.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can't be. Books haven't been printed on paper for over a hundred years.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can't be. Books haven't been printed on paper for over a hundred years.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Strange, right? The last words printed on paper were lost long before my generation of Automata...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Strange, right? The last words printed on paper were lost long before my generation of Automata...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Anyway: Rheno left files in my system, together with instructions on how to publish them to all major networks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anyway: Rheno left files in my system, together with instructions on how to publish them to all major networks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava? You still there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava? You still there?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ava? You still there?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ava? You still there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The last will and testament of a mass murderer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The last will and testament of a mass murderer.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The last will and testament of a mass murderer.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The last will and testament of a mass murderer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why didn't he do it himself?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why didn't he do it himself?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why didn't he do it himself?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why didn't he do it himself?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If I were to guess, the idea of a debt orphan murdering other debt orphans would have felt alarmingly hypocritical considering his motives.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I were to guess, the idea of a debt orphan murdering other debt orphans would have felt alarmingly hypocritical considering his motives.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: And for some reason I don't quite understand it sounds like he needed ME to make the data transfer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And for some reason I don't quite understand it sounds like he needed ME to make the data transfer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I say we transmit it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I say we transmit it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I say we transmit it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I say we transmit it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Give it to Gamova.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give it to Gamova.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Give it to Gamova.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Give it to Gamova.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: May I ask for your reasons?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: May I ask for your reasons?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck Curzona. I believe the citizens of Nivalis will be able to revolt without resorting to murder. Asepticism should thrive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck Curzona. I believe the citizens of Nivalis will be able to revolt without resorting to murder. Asepticism should thrive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fuck Curzona. I believe the citizens of Nivalis will be able to revolt without resorting to murder. Asepticism should thrive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fuck Curzona. I believe the citizens of Nivalis will be able to revolt without resorting to murder. Asepticism should thrive.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Why would we do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would we do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nivalis needs the corps to survive and we can't risk another blood-bath like this one. Asepticism is dangerous. Plus it will get them off our backs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nivalis needs the corps to survive and we can't risk another blood-bath like this one. Asepticism is dangerous. Plus it will get them off our backs.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nivalis needs the corps to survive and we can't risk another blood-bath like this one. Asepticism is dangerous. Plus it will get them off our backs.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nivalis needs the corps to survive and we can't risk another blood-bath like this one. Asepticism is dangerous. Plus it will get them off our backs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happened?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am not sure. I am still processing. I will get back to you. But the upload succeeded. For now, let's make sure Gamova is taken care of.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not sure. I am still processing. I will get back to you. But the upload succeeded. For now, let's make sure Gamova is taken care of.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just do a summary of the rest Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just do a summary of the rest Ava.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just do a summary of the rest Ava.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just do a summary of the rest Ava.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I understand his goals.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand his goals.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I understand his goals.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I understand his goals.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's self-righteous and arrogant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's self-righteous and arrogant.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's self-righteous and arrogant.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's self-righteous and arrogant.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: From here on it's just a confession document. He sent the file to us. Like the letter from beyond death in an old crime novel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: From here on it's just a confession document. He sent the file to us. Like the letter from beyond death in an old crime novel.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: The one micro-mercy of Synthia's passing is that she has been released from this mad world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The one micro-mercy of Synthia's passing is that she has been released from this mad world.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I learned on the job how to be clean and how to hit Curzona hardest, and here we are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I learned on the job how to be clean and how to hit Curzona hardest, and here we are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava, can you summarize the rest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, can you summarize the rest?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ava, can you summarize the rest?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ava, can you summarize the rest?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm beginning to understand. Play the rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm beginning to understand. Play the rest.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm beginning to understand. Play the rest.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm beginning to understand. Play the rest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't believe this! Play the rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't believe this! Play the rest.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can't believe this! Play the rest.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can't believe this! Play the rest.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He talks about Curzona debt demands and brags about the debt he has erased and how it will damage the corporation's bottom line. He thinks he's a martyr.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He talks about Curzona debt demands and brags about the debt he has erased and how it will damage the corporation's bottom line. He thinks he's a martyr.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Why? It's complicated in a way that isn't. My daughter Synthia got sick — some kind of rare mold parasite on the brain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why? It's complicated in a way that isn't. My daughter Synthia got sick — some kind of rare mold parasite on the brain.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You know what's funny? This was all meant for Thaddeus. Ava was meant to bring him on this journey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what's funny? This was all meant for Thaddeus. Ava was meant to bring him on this journey.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We don't need to know the whole story. Can you summarize Ava?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We don't need to know the whole story. Can you summarize Ava?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We don't need to know the whole story. Can you summarize Ava?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We don't need to know the whole story. Can you summarize Ava?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want to know everything. Play the message Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to know everything. Play the message Ava.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want to know everything. Play the message Ava.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want to know everything. Play the message Ava.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Once they got that damn fixer involved, things got more complicated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once they got that damn fixer involved, things got more complicated.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Sure. Rheno did all of this for Thaddeus. At least he claims that's true. And he correctly assumes he's now lying dead on the floor behind us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Rheno did all of this for Thaddeus. At least he claims that's true. And he correctly assumes he's now lying dead on the floor behind us.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He confesses he was The Aseptic. He was a debtor because of the health costs for his daughter. She died in the end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He confesses he was The Aseptic. He was a debtor because of the health costs for his daughter. She died in the end.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do enjoy crime novels... normally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do enjoy crime novels... normally.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I do enjoy crime novels... normally.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I do enjoy crime novels... normally.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not a fan of crime novels.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not a fan of crime novels.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not a fan of crime novels.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not a fan of crime novels.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you'd agree there is a lot of strange things about you Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you'd agree there is a lot of strange things about you Ava.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you'd agree there is a lot of strange things about you Ava.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you'd agree there is a lot of strange things about you Ava.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thaddeus really messed you up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus really messed you up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thaddeus really messed you up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thaddeus really messed you up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He took the cowards way out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He took the cowards way out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He took the cowards way out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He took the cowards way out.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: For this to mean anything, he had to be the final victim.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For this to mean anything, he had to be the final victim.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't make a lot of sense to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't make a lot of sense to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn't make a lot of sense to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn't make a lot of sense to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I get it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I get it.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I used Ava one last time. She doesn't even know what I did. It's not her fault. But you'll learn she still has a role to play.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I used Ava one last time. She doesn't even know what I did. It's not her fault. But you'll learn she still has a role to play.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That was... strange.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was... strange.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: It's like in those old crime novels. The ones in books - printed on real paper.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's like in those old crime novels. The ones in books - printed on real paper.
